title: Programming & AI
description: A free, practical path from programming foundations to software engineering, machine learning, deep learning, web applications and real-world AI systems.
audience: Beginners and self-taught learners who want to build strong programming fundamentals and progress toward practical AI and software development.

phases.title: Foundation
phases.description: Understand what code is, become comfortable with the terminal, and learn the development tools used throughout the program.

phases.title: Thinking Like a Programmer
phases.description: Build strong Python fundamentals and learn to reason about data and programs from first principles.

phases.title: Building Software
phases.description: Turn programming knowledge into useful software by working with text, web data, embeddings and application building blocks.

phases.title: Teaching Computers to Learn
phases.description: Learn machine learning, deep learning and the practical foundations behind modern AI systems.

phases.title: Build Web Applications
phases.description: Build modern web applications and connect software ideas to interfaces people can actually use.

phases.title: Make Applications Real
phases.description: Move from projects to production-minded applications, deployment and real-world software engineering workflows.
